title: ChatChoiceResponseBlock
description: Structured response to a prior choicePrompt block. Use choiceId for single-select, choiceIds for multi-select, or text for freeform override responses.

questionId.description: Correlates this response with the originating prompt.

responseKind.description: Whether this response selected provided choices or used a freeform override.

choiceId.description: Selected choice id for single-select prompts.

choiceIds.description: Selected choice ids for multi-select prompts.

label.description: Optional echoed display label for transcript readability.

labels.description: Optional echoed display labels for transcript readability.

examples.text: Use the backup collector in site DR.
